personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: A mission that stopped on the tool's bug carries on by itself once the fix is out: I lose a night, not a week.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: I never see the team; I only read that my blocked PRD resumed, and why.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: One pull request per bug, most-reported first, a person merges: I can keep the kit cohesive.

personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: Fixes written from a short report, by a bot, shipped to everyone in the next release: that is how slop reaches production.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: States in a table I can query and three tries per bug; still, a resume gated on a version string is one more thing to debug.

objection.text: A bot fixing the tool's own bugs from a three-line report, the most-reported first, will rush out a patch that hides the symptom, and a release ships it to every repository that runs Omni Loop.
